model.title: The smart way to own the Caribbean
model.description: We structure and manage fractional co-ownership of luxury second homes, through an S.A.S. company and professional hotel operation, to make the investment and the running costs efficient in properties that are used little during the year. We take part as founding co-owners in every project.

hero.headline: Business model
hero.title: Fractional co-ownership, explained from start to finish
hero.description: You buy 1/8 of a premium holiday property, registered in your name in trust, and a single operator takes care of everything else. This is how it works and how you become the owner of a fraction.

structure.headline: How it is built
structure.title: One property, eight owners, one operation
structure.description: Every property is structured the same way, and that is what makes co-ownership run without friction.

fractions.title: Eight equal fractions
fractions.description: Each property is divided into exactly eight fractions. You buy one and become a co-owner alongside seven partners, on the same terms.

ownership.title: Real ownership, in trust
ownership.description: An S.A.S. company owns the property and your 1/8 is shares in that company, registered in the project trust: real, traceable and transferable ownership.

seasons.title: Usage rights by season
seasons.description: Each fraction gets six weeks a year spread across the four seasons, with a picking order that rotates every year so the split stays fair.

operation.title: Centralised operation
operation.description: Scheduling, shared expenses, maintenance, suppliers and communication live on the platform. You use it; Arena and the operator do the rest.

whatWeDo.headline: What Arena Property does
whatWeDo.title: Three things for every property
whatWeDo.description: And all three are permanent over time, except the first.
whatWeDo.partner: Arena also joins as one more partner, on the same terms as everyone else. Its income is a declared fee for structuring each company and a monthly fee for managing it.

structure.title: We structure
structure.description: We analyse the asset, gather a closed group of nominated partners and incorporate the company that buys the property, divided into eight equal fractions.

commercialize.title: We place
commercialize.description: We find and qualify the partners of each property. Placement is private and one to one, never open.

manage.title: We manage
manage.description: We are the property manager for as long as the company exists. Cleaning, maintenance, suppliers, property tax, insurance, utilities and the relationship with the tourism operator go through us, not the partners.

fund.title: Not a fund
fund.description: Nor a proprietary capital vehicle: you buy a stake in the company that owns one specific property.

timeshare.title: Not a timeshare
timeshare.description: You are a shareholder of the company that owns the property, with real and transferable ownership.

yield.title: No promise of operating returns
yield.description: The return comes from use and possible appreciation, not from rent. Nothing estimated is presented as confirmed.

path.headline: How you become an owner
path.title: From visitor to owner, step by step
path.description: Five steps, three roles. None of them commits you ahead of time.

explore.title: Explore the properties
explore.description: Browse the catalogue, each property page and this model. No account and no commitment.

account.title: Create your account
account.description: With your email or with Google. If you arrived through an Ambassador, their code is recorded.

choose.title: Choose your fraction
choose.description: You write to us from the property page, we answer your questions and close the purchase with an agreed price and a payment plan.

pay.title: Pay your plan
pay.description: In instalments and without an additional mortgage. Every payment is recorded and visible from your dashboard.

own.title: Use your fraction
own.description: Once the plan is complete your calendar activates: you pick your weeks on your turn and the operator takes care of the rest.

cta.title: Start by creating your account
cta.description: It is free and commits you to nothing. From there we walk with you all the way to your registered fraction.

hero.headline: Benefits
hero.title: Eight owners, zero worries
hero.description: You own your holiday home in the Caribbean for a fraction of the investment and the running costs. Compare the fraction with buying a whole property.

comparison.headline: Comparison
comparison.title: Whole property versus fraction
comparison.description: Every figure says whether it is a fact or an estimate. Nothing estimated is presented as confirmed.

usage.traditional: All year, with the property empty most of the time
usage.fractional: Six weeks a year, 42 nights, across the four seasons

income.traditional: You manage it yourself, if you manage to rent it
income.fractional: The weeks you do not use are rented by the operator and the income is shared with your 1/8

expenses.fractional: 1/8 of shared expenses, with a monthly report

operation.traditional: Cleaning, maintenance, suppliers, property tax and insurance depend on you
operation.fractional: Arena manages and a tourism operator handles guests and reporting

ownership.fractional: Shares of the S.A.S. that owns the property, in trust and transferable

list.headline: What you gain
list.title: Six reasons to choose the fraction
list.description: The best of the Caribbean for a part of the cost, without carrying the operation.

capital.title: A fraction of the capital
capital.description: From COP $173M in 30 instalments, instead of more than COP $1,384M for the whole apartment.

weeks.title: 42 nights a year

income.title: Income when you are not using it

management.title: Centralised operation

cta.description: Create your account and we will tell you which fractions are left and how to close yours.

hero.headline: Scheduling system
hero.title: Six weeks a year per fraction
hero.description: In luxury co-ownership the promise is expressed in weeks: 1/8 equals six weeks a year, which are exactly 42 nights spread by season. This is how they are picked, used and rotated.

seasons.headline: Your annual allowance
seasons.title: Four seasons, 42 nights
seasons.description: Every fraction gets the same allowance. The grid runs Saturday to Saturday and every week belongs to a season.

rules.headline: The rules
rules.title: Full transparency before you buy
rules.description: What you see here is what the system applies. The page promises nothing different from the engine that allocates the weeks.

whole_weeks.title: Use by whole weeks
whole_weeks.description: Each week runs Saturday to Saturday, check-in at 15:00 and check-out at 11:00. You pick and use whole weeks.

turns.title: Selection by turns
turns.description: The Administrator opens the selection for the year and each fraction picks its weeks on its turn, following the published order.

rotation.title: Yearly rotation of the order
rotation.description: The picking order rotates every year: whoever picked first goes last. Nobody repeats an advantage.

peaks.title: Peak blocks with strict rotation
peaks.description: Christmas, New Year and Holy Week are peak blocks within the high season and rotate among the eight fractions with the same discipline.

relocation.title: Yearly relocation window
relocation.description: Every year a window opens, by turns, to move a picked and unconfirmed week to another free week of the same season.

confirmation.title: Confirmation and rental
confirmation.description: You confirm each week up to 60 days before its check-in Saturday. A week left unconfirmed goes to the rental pool and the income is shared with your fraction.

cta.title: Your turn starts with your account
cta.description: Create your account, choose your fraction and, once the plan is complete, your calendar is active.

whoWeAre.headline: Who we are
whoWeAre.title: We structure, place and manage
whoWeAre.description: Arena Property structures and manages fractional co-ownership of luxury second homes, through an S.A.S. company and professional hotel operation, to make the investment and the running costs efficient in properties that are used little during the year.
whoWeAre.founder: We take part as founding co-owners in every project, on the same terms as the other partners.

structure.title: We structure
structure.description: We analyse the asset, gather a closed group of partners and incorporate the company that buys the property in eight equal fractions.

commercialize.title: We place
commercialize.description: We find and qualify the partners of each property, privately and one to one.

manage.title: We manage
manage.description: We are the manager for as long as the company exists: cleaning, maintenance, suppliers, property tax, insurance and the relationship with the operator.

faq.headline: Frequently asked questions
faq.title: What everyone asks before buying
faq.description: Short, honest answers. If anything is still unclear, write to us.

what_is.question: What exactly is a fraction?
what_is.answer: It is 1/8 of a holiday property. An S.A.S. company owns the property and your fraction is shares in that company, registered in the project trust.

ownership.question: Is the fraction really mine?
ownership.answer: Yes. It is real, traceable and transferable ownership. It is not a timeshare or a right of use: you are a shareholder of the company that owns the property.

weeks.question: How many weeks can I use per year?
weeks.answer: Six whole weeks, which are 42 nights: one in high season, one in mid-high, one in mid and three in low. The picking order rotates every year.

expenses.question: Who pays the property expenses?
expenses.answer: The eight co-owners, in proportion to their fraction: 1/8 each. Arena manages the shared expenses and delivers a monthly report with every peso recorded.

income.question: Do I earn income when I am not using it?
income.answer: The weeks you do not confirm go to the rental pool. The operator rents them to third parties and the income is shared with your fraction. It is variable income, never a promise.

transfer.question: Can I sell or transfer my fraction?
transfer.answer: Yes. The fraction is transferable; Arena records the transfer as an audited operation, deciding with you what happens to the weeks and pending instalments.

operator.question: Who looks after the guests?
operator.answer: A single tourism operator handles rentals, guests and reporting. You do not look after anyone: you simply use your fraction when it is your turn.

arena_role.question: What does Arena Property earn?
arena_role.answer: A declared fee for structuring each company and a monthly fee for managing it. We also join as one more partner, on the same terms as everyone else.

testimonials.headline: Voices from the team
testimonials.title: Commitment on every front
testimonials.description: What we take on for each partner, in the words of the people who do it.

structuring.author: Structuring team
structuring.quote: Every company is born with clear accounts: eight equal fractions, a price agreed in writing and ownership in trust from day one.

administration.author: Property management
administration.quote: Our job is that the partner never has to think about the operation. Every expense is recorded and every month the report arrives.

operator.author: Tourism operation
operator.quote: We look after every guest as if the owner were watching, because they actually are: they see every rental and every income in their dashboard.

trust.title: The trust
trust.description: The autonomous estate where the ownership of each fraction is registered. It is what makes your property traceable before third parties.

company.title: The S.A.S.
company.description: The simplified joint-stock company that buys the property. Your shares in it are your fraction.

operator.title: The tourism operator
operator.description: The single partner that rents the free weeks, looks after guests and delivers monthly reporting.

expenses.title: Shared expenses
expenses.description: Cleaning, maintenance, property tax, insurance and utilities, shared among the eight fractions and reported every month.

transfer.title: Transfer
transfer.description: The change of owner of a fraction, recorded by Arena as an audited operation.

hero.headline: Ambassador Program
hero.title: Earn a commission for every referral who buys
hero.description: Anyone with an account can enrol as an Ambassador, receive a unique code and introduce Arena Property to whoever wants to own a fraction. When your referral completes payment, your commission is released.

flow.headline: How it works
flow.title: Four steps
flow.description: From the link you share to the commission in your balance.

refer.title: I refer
refer.description: You share your link or your code. Whoever arrives through it is attributed to you for {days} days.

purchase.title: My referral buys
purchase.description: They close the purchase of a fraction with an agreed price and a payment plan. You see it in your dashboard as “payment in progress”.

pay.title: They pay in full
pay.description: When they complete the plan, your commission is calculated on the agreed price of that purchase.

release.title: My commission is released
release.description: After {days} days of grace it moves to your available balance and you can request a withdrawal.

commission.headline: Current commission
commission.title: What the program pays today
commission.description: The amount is set by Arena Property and published here exactly as configured. No fine print.
commission.percentageHint: On the price agreed in your referral’s purchase.
commission.fixedHint: For every referral who completes payment for their fraction.
commission.unavailable: The commission amount will be published as soon as it is configured.

terms.headline: Terms
terms.title: The program rules, in short
terms.description: The same ones the platform applies. You accept the full terms when you enrol.

window.title: {days}-day window
window.description: A referral counts if they sign up within {days} days of their first click on your link.

first_click.title: First attribution wins
first_click.description: If they arrived through several links, the first valid one counts.

no_self.title: No self-referrals
no_self.description: Your own email or your own account earn no commission.

one_commission.title: One commission per referral
one_commission.description: Only a referral’s first fraction purchase earns a commission.

grace.title: {days} days of grace
grace.description: The commission stays in grace from full payment and then becomes available. If the purchase is voided within that period, it is reversed.

minimum.title: Withdrawal with a minimum
minimum.description: You choose how much to withdraw from your available balance, with a minimum per withdrawal set by Arena.

roles.title: Who can enrol
roles.description: Users and Owners. The Superadmin and property Administrators do not take part.

cta.description: Create your account, enrol in the program and receive your code.
